Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১) Tk. 1400 is lent out at 5% per annum simple interest for 4 years. Find the amount after 4 years.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: Tk. 1400 is lent out at 5% per annum simple interest for 4 years. Find the amount after 4 years.

Solution:
We know,
A = p(1 + nr)
= 1400 {1 + (4 × 5)/100}
= 1400 × (120/100)
= 1680

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ২) The simple interest at m% for m years will be Tk. m on a sum of?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: The simple interest at m% for m years will be Tk. m on a sum of?

Solution:
Given, 
Rate of interest, r = m%
Interest, I = m Tk.
Time, n = m yeras.

We know,
I = Pnr
P = I/nr
= (m × 100)/(m × m)
= 100/m Tk.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৩) A farmer borrowed Tk. 3600 at 15% simple interest per annum. At the end of 4 years, he cleared this account by paying Tk. 4000 and a goat. The cost of the goat is-
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: A farmer borrowed Tk. 3600 at 15% simple interest per annum. At the end of 4 years, he cleared this account by paying Tk. 4000 and a goat. The cost of the goat is-

Solution: 
S.I for 4 years = Tk. (3600 × 15 × 4​)/100
= Tk. 2160

Amount after 4 years = Tk. (3600 + 2160) = Tk.  5760

Cost of goat = Tk. (5760 - 4000) = Tk. 1760

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৪) Compound interest on a certain sum at the rate of 10% per annum after 2 years is Tk. 4410. Find the simple interest on that sum at the rate of 12% per annum for 5 years.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: Compound interest on a certain sum at the rate of 10% per annum after 2 years is Tk. 4410. Find the simple interest on that sum at the rate of 12% per annum for 5 years.

Solution:
Let the sum be, x.
Rate of interest = 10%
Period = 2 years

Hence, compound interest = x(1 + 10/100)2 - x = 4410
⇒ x × 1.21 - x = 4410
⇒ 0.21x = 4410
⇒ x = 4410/0.21
∴ x = 21000

Hence, simple interest = 21000 × (12/100) × 5
= 12600

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৫) How much time will it take for an amount of Tk. 450 to yield Tk. 81 as interest at 9% per annum of simple interest?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: How much time will it take for an amount of Tk. 450 to yield Tk. 81 as interest at 9% per annum of simple interest?

Solution: 
I = Pnr
⇒ 81 = 450 × n × 9/100
∴ n = (81 × 100)/(450 × 9)
= 2 years

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৬) A sum of money amounts to Tk. 5200 in 5 years and to Tk. 5680 in 7 years at simple interest. The rate of interest per annum is?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: A sum of money amounts to Tk. 5200 in 5 years and to Tk. 5680 in 7 years at simple interest. The rate of interest per annum is?

Solution:
Simple interest for 2 years = (5680 - 5200) Tk.
= Tk. 480
∴ Simple Interest for 2 years =  Tk. 480
∴ Simple Interest for 5 years =  Tk. (480 × 5/2)
= Tk. 1200
∴ Principal = 5200 - 1200 = Tk. 4000.

We know, 
I = Pnr
⇒ r = I/Pn
 ⇒ r = (1200 × 100)/(4000 × 5)
∴ r = 6%

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৭) Find the difference between the simple interest and the compound interest at 5% per annum for 2 years on a principal of Tk 2000.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: Find the difference between the simple interest and the compound interest at 5% per annum for 2 years on a principal of Tk 2000.

Solution:
We know, Simple Interest, I = pnr
and Compound Principal, C = p(1 + r)n

Simple Interest = 2000 × 2 × (5/100) = 200 Tk

Compound Principal = 2000 × (1 + 5/100)2
= 2000 × (105/100)2
= (2000 × 105 × 105)/(100 × 100)
= 2205

So, Compound interest = 2205 - 2000 = 205 Tk

So, difference = 205 - 200 = 5 Tk.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৮) If simple interest on a certain sum of money is Tk. 225 and the rate of interest per annum equals the number of years, then the rate of interest is-
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: If simple interest on a certain sum of money is Tk. 225 and the rate of interest per annum equals the number of years, then the rate of interest is-

Solution:
Let,
The rate of interest is x%
∴ Number of years is x

The interest of 1 year of 100 taka is x
∴ The interest of x years of 100 Taka is x × x = x2

ATQ,
x2 = 225 
∴ x = 15

∴ The rate of interest is 15%

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৯) At the rate of (17/2)% p.a. simple interest, a sum of Tk. 4800 will earn how much interest in 2 years 3 months?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: At the rate of (17/2)% p.a. simple interest, a sum of Tk. 4800 will earn how much interest in 2 years 3 months?

Solution:
Time, n = 2 years 3 months = 2(1/4) years = 9/4 years.

We know,
I = Pnr
= 4800 × (9/4) × (17/2) × (1/100)
= Tk. 918

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১০) The population of a village decreases at the rate of 25% per annum. If its population 2 years ago was 24000, the present population is =?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: The population of a village decreases at the rate of 25% per annum. If its population 2 years ago was 24000, the present population is =?

Solution: 
Given that,
The population of a village 2 years ago = 24000
Rate of growth = 25% p.a.
Time period = 2 years

Present population = P{(1 - (r/100)}n
= 24000 × {1 - (25/100)}2
= 24000 × {1 - (1/4)}2
= 24000 × (3/4)2
= 24000 × (9/16)
= 13500

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১১) A certain sum of money yields Tk. 1261 as compound interest for three years at 5% per annum. The sum is ?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: A certain sum of money yields Tk. 1261 as compound interest for three years at 5% per annum. The sum is ?

Solution: 
Let the principal be Tk. P

Now,
1261 = P(1 + r)n - P
1261 = P(1 + 5/100)3 - P
1261 = P(105/100)3  - P
1261 = P(21/20)3 - P
1261 = P(9261/8000 - 1)
1261 = P (1261/8000)
1 = P/8000
P = 8000

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১২) On a sum of money, the simple interest for 2 years is Tk. 660, while the compound interest is Tk. 696.30, the rate of interest being the same in both cases. The rate of interest is -
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: On a sum of money, the simple interest for 2 years is Tk. 660, while the compound interest is Tk. 696.30, the rate of interest being the same in both cases. The rate of interest is -

Solution:
Difference of Compound interest and Simple interest for 2 years = Tk. (696.30 - 660) = Tk. 36.30
Simple interest for 1 years = 660/2 = Tk. 330

Simple interest on 330 for 1 year = 36.30
Interst rate = {(36.30 × 100)/330}% = 11%

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৩) Tahsan took a loan at simple interest rate of 6 p.c.p.a. in the first year and it increased by 1.5 p.c.p.a. every year. If he pays Tk. 8190 as interest at the end of 3 years, what was his loan amount?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: Tahsan took a loan at simple interest rate of 6 p.c.p.a. in the first year and it increased by 1.5 p.c.p.a. every year. If he pays Tk. 8190 as interest at the end of 3 years, what was his loan amount?

Solution:
Let the loan amount be Tk. x

ATQ,
6% of x  + 7.5% of x + 9% of x = 8190
⇒ (6x/100) + (7.5x/100) + (9x/100) = 8190
⇒ 22.5x = 819000
∴ x = 36400

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৪) In how many years will Tk. 2000 amounts to Tk. 2420 at 10% per annum compound interest?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: In how many years will Tk. 2000 amounts to Tk. 2420 at 10% per annum compound interest?

Solution: 
Principal = Tk. 2000
Amount = Tk. 2420
Rate = 10% 

We Know
C = P(1 + r)n
2420 = 2000(1 + 10/100)n
2420/2000 = (11/10)n
121/100 = (11/10)n
(11/10)2 = (11/10)n
n = 2

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৫) Asif obtained an amount of Tk. 8376 as simple interest on a certain amount at 8 p.c.p.a. after 6 years. What is the amount invested by Asif?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: Asif obtained an amount of Tk. 8376 as simple interest on a certain amount at 8 p.c.p.a. after 6 years. What is the amount invested by Asif?

Solution:
Simple interest, I = Tk. 8376
Rate of interest, r = 8%
Time, n = 6 years

We know,
I = Pnr
Or, P = I/nr
= (8376 × 100)/(6 × 8)
∴ P = 17450 Tk.
